ablation_name.description: What was removed (the surveillance group; a stream; a lever).

AtlAlertBudget.description: Precision and recall at one alert rate — nominal, and (0.4.0) realised where the threshold was fixed beforehand.

rate.description: The NOMINAL alert rate — the budget (fraction of patient-steps the threshold was set to flag). Where the threshold was fixed beforehand (`threshold_from: validation`), the rate actually flagged on test is `realised_rate`.

realised_rate.description: 0.4.0 (M-1e): the fraction of test patient-steps actually flagged at the threshold fixed beforehand — beside the nominal `rate`, never instead of it (SO-9). REQUIRED when threshold_from = validation (AtlAlertBudget rule). Controls: neg_realised_rate_gt1 (range) · neg_budget_validation_without_realised_rate · neg_budget_realised_rate_null. Nearest miss NOT caught: a realised rate that is not n_alerts / n_test (arithmetic across slots is the emitter's, not a schema's).

threshold_from.description: 0.4.0 (M-1e): where the alert threshold was fixed. Optional so that grandfathered entries (v0, v1: test quantiles, disclosed as F-8) still validate; atlantis_core.board refuses to EMIT `test`. Control: neg_unknown_threshold_from.

AtlAlertBudget.title: AtlAlertBudget

AtlCitation.description: 0.9.0. The cited work. Its DOI (or URL) must appear in the ledger's corpus manifest (atlantis_core check).

doi.description: 0.9.0. A bare DOI (10.xxxx/…), no resolver prefix. Control: neg_hypothesis_doi_malformed (a `https://doi.org/` prefix). Required unless `url` is given (AtlCitation rule).

url.description: 0.9.0. For a work with no DOI (an agency report). Control: neg_hypothesis_url_malformed.

AtlCitation.title: AtlCitation

AtlDataPin.description: One stream the model saw, pinned by hash.

sha256.description: Of the cached artifact; lowercase hex64. Required on AtlDataPin; recommended on a stream. Control: neg_sha256_not_hex64 (a 63-char hash on a data pin). Nearest miss NOT caught: a well-formed hash of the wrong bytes — only re-hashing the cache proves a pin.

AtlDataPin.title: AtlDataPin

AtlDeclared.description: Mixin — every declared object carries a tier, a version and who/when.

name.description: Human label. Never a partner site's name when the instance's posture is partner or human_subject.

recorded_by.description: Agent or operator id (e.g. agent_proteus, stanley).

version.description: Semantic version of the declared object.

AtlDeclared.title: AtlDeclared

AtlDocument.description: Container used to validate instance registry files; any file may carry any subset.

hypotheses.description: 0.9.0. For controls and bulk validation; a ledger row file holds ONE hypothesis at top level, validated -C AtlHypothesis.

AtlDocument.title: AtlDocument

AtlEvaluation.description: The measurement is the artifact (ADR-057). Always against its base rate, at a budget, with lead time, with its ablations, with its data pins and its limitations. This is what crosses to the board — metrics only. CLOSED (gen-json-schema --closed; linkml-validate is closed by default): control neg_per_patient_predictions proves a per-patient `predictions` list is rejected AT the evaluation; neg_budget_extra_key (a part) and neg_document_extra_key (the root) prove closed-ness at the other two levels. Nearest miss NOT caught: per-patient values smuggled inside a declared free-text slot (e.g. `split`, `learner`) — a reviewer's catch, not a shape's.

ablations.description: Surveillance ablation is REQUIRED where a surveillance channel is declared (T5).

alert_budgets.description: At least one (T6; SO-9 — operator ruling at M-1c to enforce now, not at M-1b). Controls: neg_evaluation_without_budget (absent) · neg_evaluation_empty_budgets (`[]`). Nearest miss NOT caught: a budget whose precision/recall were not measured at that rate.

base_rate.description: Test prevalence. REQUIRED — a score without its base rate is not a result (Proteus doctrine 2; SO-9). Controls: neg_missing_base_rate · neg_base_rate_gt1 (1.5). Nearest miss NOT caught: base_rate ≠ n_positives / n_test (cross-field arithmetic is a validator's job).

base_rate_train.description: 0.7.0 (M-2b, ruling 16). Prevalence of the training years' modelling rows. With base_rate_validation and base_rate (test) it makes a non-stationary base rate visible: a threshold fixed on validation meets the test base rate, so a shift between segments moves every budget's realised precision (SO-9). Controls: pos_evaluation_baselines_and_segments · neg_base_rate_train_gt1. Nearest miss NOT caught: a rate ≠ that segment's positives / n (cross-field arithmetic is the emitter's).

base_rate_validation.description: 0.7.0 (M-2b, ruling 16). Prevalence of the validation years' modelling rows (the years every threshold is fixed on). Controls: pos_evaluation_baselines_and_segments · neg_base_rate_validation_negative.

calibration_in_the_large_test.description: 0.7.0 (M-2b, ruling 16). Mean predicted probability − observed prevalence on test. Controls: pos_evaluation_baselines_and_segments · neg_calibration_in_the_large_test_lt_minus1.

calibration_in_the_large_validation.description: 0.7.0 (M-2b, ruling 16). Mean predicted probability − observed prevalence on the validation stop set: 0 is calibrated in the large, > 0 over-predicts. Beside the test value it shows calibration under a base-rate shift. Controls: pos_evaluation_baselines_and_segments · neg_calibration_in_the_large_validation_gt1. Nearest miss NOT caught: a value that is not mean(p) − prevalence.

claim.description: SO-4. REQUIRED and written out: neither validator applies `ifabsent`, so an evaluation without `claim` is rejected rather than defaulted (the default documents intent for generators). Controls: neg_missing_claim · neg_unknown_claim.

climatology_alert_budgets.description: 0.8.0 (M-2c-i; P2 gate III G-3, C-034). T11 at its terms: the week-of-year climatology scored at the same nominal budgets as the model, each threshold fixed on validation by a climatology fit on train only (embargoed), applied to the refit's test scores, with the realised rate beside the nominal one — the AtlAlertBudget rule (validation ⇒ realised_rate) applies here as on `alert_budgets`. Climatology scores tie in whole week-of-year groups, so the realised rate departs from the nominal one by construction. Optional: entries before 0.8.0 still validate. Controls: pos_evaluation_climatology_budget_and_interval · neg_climatology_budget_without_realised_rate. Nearest miss NOT caught: a threshold quantiled from test while labelled `validation` (atlantis_core: eval's invariance test and plant C1 in tests/test_m2c.py; board.assert_climatology_at_budget).

climatology_auroc.description: The cheapest baseline (T11). Required from M-1b on.

config_hash.description: Hash of the instance's config.yaml at training time.

data_pins.description: Every stream the model saw, with its sha256.

embargo_weeks.description: 0.6.0 (M-1f). The label-horizon embargo the evaluation's fit and stop sets were cut with: the rows whose label window t+1…t+H reads the period a set must not see were dropped (III M-1e F-6). 0 = none; ≥ the event horizon when on (atlantis_core refuses a partial embargo). Optional so that grandfathered entries (v0–v2, unembargoed and disclosed as such) still validate. It is E as resolved and applied, and the emitter states it only when every boundary was checked; what proves the cut is atlantis_core.board.assert_embargo (each boundary's label window ends before the year the split names, and it dropped at least the rows whose H-week window crosses), not this number (III M-1f F-3). Controls: pos_evaluation_embargo · neg_evaluation_embargo_negative · neg_evaluation_embargo_float. Nearest miss NOT caught: an embargo shorter than the horizon (H lives on the event, not the evaluation — cross-object arithmetic is the emitter's).

learner.description: xgboost 3.4.1 · depth 4 · eta 0.03 · logloss early-stop — or the swap.

limitations_ref.description: Pointer to the published page's Limitations section. REQUIRED and non-blank: no evaluation without its limits (SO-4, SO-9). Controls: neg_missing_limitations_ref (absent) · neg_limitations_ref_blank (`'  '`). Nearest miss NOT caught: a pointer to a page with no Limitations section (referential integrity).

name.description: Human label. Never a partner site's name when the instance's posture is partner or human_subject.

owner_ruling_ref.description: REQUIRED and non-blank when claim = operational_by_owner_ruling (AtlEvaluation rule).

paired_intervals.description: 0.8.0 (M-2c-i). model − comparator on a threshold-free metric, with a percentile interval from season-block draws (whole test years, the same draw scoring both: paired). Read with n_blocks: with B blocks only C(2B−1, B) distinct draws exist (35 at B = 4), so the interval is crude; one that spans 0 means 'not distinguished at this sample', never 'no difference'. Optional. Controls: pos_evaluation_climatology_budget_and_interval · neg_interval_extra_key (per-draw values cannot ride along). Nearest miss NOT caught: an interval whose draws were not paired (atlantis_core: the identical-scores control in tests/test_m2c.py fails under plant C4 — the proof is that control, not a guard; III M-2c-i F-8). The level is NOMINAL: at small n_blocks a percentile interval under-covers, so 'spans 0: no' is not 'distinguished at that level' (III M-2c-i F-2); the board carries the per-season deltas and a sign test beside it.

persistence_auprc.description: 0.7.0 (M-2b, ruling 19). As persistence_auroc. Controls: pos_evaluation_baselines_and_segments · neg_persistence_auprc_negative.

persistence_auroc.description: 0.7.0 (M-2b, ruling 19). The no-model, no-fit comparator: test rows ranked by the event signal itself at t, carried forward as the label carries it (`last_known_weeks`) — the honest floor where the event variable is also a vital (DHW accumulates, so DHW(t) nearly decides DHW(t+k); SO-9). Optional: entries before 0.7.0 still validate. Controls: pos_evaluation_baselines_and_segments · neg_persistence_auroc_gt1. Nearest miss NOT caught: a persistence score that read s(t+1) (a leak is the emitter's and its tests', not a shape's).

recorded_by.description: Agent or operator id (e.g. agent_proteus, stanley).

shap_summary_ref.description: Pointer to the instance's shap_summary (mean |SHAP| per vital and group); never per-patient values.

split.description: Temporal split in words: train 1994–2016 · val 2017–2019 · test 2020–2023, scored once.

trend_auprc.description: 0.7.0 (M-2b, ruling 19). As trend_auroc. Controls: pos_evaluation_baselines_and_segments · neg_trend_auprc_gt1.

trend_auroc.description: 0.7.0 (M-2b, ruling 19). A logistic fit on [s(t), s(t) − s(t−1)] — the signal and its last step — fitted on the rows the refit trains on (train ∪ embargoed val, as climatology), scored once on test. What the model adds beyond the event signal's own recent path. Controls: pos_evaluation_baselines_and_segments · neg_trend_auroc_gt1. Nearest miss NOT caught: a trend fitted on test rows, or a step input that read s(t+1) (atlantis_core's: eval's fit_years and check_label_windows; plants B1 and S3 in tests/test_baselines.py, III M-2b F-1).

unit_ref.description: The patient population the evaluation covers (the parent unit when many).

version.description: Semantic version of the declared object.

AtlEvaluation.title: AtlEvaluation

AtlEventDefinition.description: Threshold · direction · horizon · onset rule. A ruling with its own version history; a second event on the same vitals is a second definition and a second model (T12).

event_variable_stream.description: The stream the event variable is read from.

horizon.description: In time steps: event within t+1 … t+horizon.

name.description: Human label. Never a partner site's name when the instance's posture is partner or human_subject.

onset_rule.description: How already-past-threshold patients are excluded (last-known state ≥ threshold → dropped) and how unknown outcomes are handled.

recorded_by.description: Agent or operator id (e.g. agent_proteus, stanley).

refractory_weeks.description: 0.5.0 (M-2a-i). Optional; absent = 0. A patient-step is dropped as already-in-event when the carried signal crossed the threshold at ANY of t−R … t, not only at t — so a persistent or flickering event (DHW decaying and re-accumulating) yields one onset, not several. R = horizon − 1 matches eval's lead-time onset (no crossing in the previous H steps); R = horizon is one step stricter. Past-only by construction: the self-test's C1/C2 prove nothing after t moves it, and C9 that it bites at its declared length. Controls: pos_event_refractory · neg_event_refractory_negative · neg_event_refractory_float.

version.description: Semantic version of the declared object.

AtlEventDefinition.title: AtlEventDefinition

AtlHypothesis.description: 0.9.0 (M-3b-i). One claim from the literature about what drives an event — mechanism · driver · lag · direction · threshold · evidence class · citation — pointing at a sentence, and saying what vital would realise it. A hypothesis, not a fact: `tier: validated` would mean two reviewers agree the extraction is faithful, never that the mechanism is true; truth is the instance's SHAP and the write-up's job (README rule 2). CLOSED: control neg_hypothesis_extra_key proves an undeclared key (an abstract pasted in) is rejected AT the row. Nearest miss NOT caught: a long quotation pasted INTO sentence_pointer or mechanism (atlantis_core check counts the pointer's words; mechanism is a reviewer's catch).

ecosystem_type.description: 0.9.0. The join key (README rule 5); also the ledger directory name (atlantis_core check). Control: neg_hypothesis_unknown_ecosystem.

event_variable.description: 0.9.0. The event the claim bears on, as the instance names it (degree_heating_week; a WoRMS taxon). Free text: a hypothesis may be read before any instance declares the event.

hyp_id.description: 0.9.0. Hypothesis id; the row's file is <hyp_id>.yaml (atlantis_core.hypotheses check). Control: neg_hypothesis_id_prefix.

mechanism.description: 0.9.0. One sentence: the paper's claim in the paper's terms. Control: neg_hypothesis_mechanism_blank.

name.description: Human label. Never a partner site's name when the instance's posture is partner or human_subject.

realisable_as.description: 0.9.0 (skill step 4). The candidate vital in stream-class terms (source · transform · lag), or `unrealisable: <why>` — T8's falsifier made visible (rows no fetcher can realise). Control: neg_hypothesis_realisable_as_blank.

realisation.description: 0.9.0. Present on every row (`result: untested` until an instance realises it); filled when an instance turns the row into a vital. Required, not optional: an optional inlined object is emitted anyOf [object, null], and a defect inside it would be rejected only as an unnamed branch (the controls could not name it).

recorded_by.description: Agent or operator id (e.g. agent_proteus, stanley).

region_asserted.description: 0.9.0. Where the paper looked (a region name; never coordinates).

reviewed_by.description: 0.9.0. Who confirmed the extraction is faithful to the cited text. REQUIRED and non-blank when tier = reviewed (AtlHypothesis rule). Nearest miss NOT caught: a reviewer who is the extractor (atlantis_core check), or `validated` with fewer than two reviewers (atlantis_core check refuses `validated` until a second-reviewer slot exists).

sentence_pointer.description: 0.9.0. README rule 1 — no pointer, no row: a section/paragraph, or a quotation of ≤ 25 words. Controls: neg_hypothesis_without_sentence_pointer (absent) · neg_hypothesis_sentence_pointer_blank. Nearest miss NOT caught: a quotation over 25 words, or one not in the paper (atlantis_core.hypotheses check: word count always; verbatim against the cached text when the cache is present).

version.description: Semantic version of the declared object.

AtlHypothesis.title: AtlHypothesis

AtlHypothesisDriver.description: 0.9.0. The driver variable as an authority names it, with its lag, direction and optional threshold.

authority.description: The vocabulary the stream's variable is named in: CF standard name, WoRMS AphiaID, Darwin Core term.

driver_lag.description: 0.9.0. Required: a realisation needs a lag. A paper that states none is recorded as lag_value 0 with lag_note `not stated — concurrent`, or an inferred lag with `inferred: <how>` (the skill, step 3). Required for the same reason as realisation.

variable.description: The driver as the authority names it (wind_speed; Niño 3.4; cloud_area_fraction).

AtlHypothesisDriver.title: AtlHypothesisDriver

AtlLagSpec.description: 0.9.0. A lag as the paper states it.
AtlLagSpec.title: AtlLagSpec

AtlLeadTime.description: Lead-time summary at one budget. Histogram stays in the instance. (0.4.0) `threshold_from` says where the threshold it reads was fixed.

budget_rate.description: The alert budget the lead time was measured at.

threshold_from.description: 0.4.0 (M-1e): where the alert threshold was fixed. Optional so that grandfathered entries (v0, v1: test quantiles, disclosed as F-8) still validate; atlantis_core.board refuses to EMIT `test`. Control: neg_unknown_threshold_from.

AtlLeadTime.title: AtlLeadTime

AtlObservationStream.description: One source of observations with Ingest-Rule-5 provenance and a content hash. The stream is the unit of fetch, cache, licence and drift detection. Observations themselves are a table shape (observation_long, type-vocabulary proposal) and never enter Atlantis.

authority.description: The vocabulary the stream's variable is named in: CF standard name, WoRMS AphiaID, Darwin Core term.

captured_at.description: Ingest Rule 5: when the source produced/last updated the data.

fetcher.description: The atlantis_core fetcher class or module that realises this stream (P1).

ingested_at.description: Ingest Rule 5: when the instance fetched it. Optional from 0.3.0 (M-1d-i operator ruling): a stream is DECLARED before its first fetch (contract item 6 — the self-test runs before any real data), and a declared stream has no fetch time to state. Required once the stream carries a sha256 (class rule on AtlObservationStream).

license.description: SPDX or the agency's terms string.

name.description: Human label. Never a partner site's name when the instance's posture is partner or human_subject.

pipeline_version.description: Ingest Rule 5: which fetcher version wrote the cache.

recorded_by.description: Agent or operator id (e.g. agent_proteus, stanley).

sha256.description: Of the cached artifact; lowercase hex64. Required on AtlDataPin; recommended on a stream. Control: neg_sha256_not_hex64 (a 63-char hash on a data pin). Nearest miss NOT caught: a well-formed hash of the wrong bytes — only re-hashing the cache proves a pin.

source_id.description: Ingest Rule 5: the id within that system (layer id, ERDDAP dataset id, NWIS site, BioProject).

source_system.description: Ingest Rule 5: the system of record (FWC ArcGIS Hub, NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP, USGS NWIS, NOAA CRW, OBIS, NCBI SRA…).

surveillance_channel.description: True if this stream's sampling intensity is itself endogenous to the event (pattern step 3; T5).

variable.description: The measured quantity as the authority names it (sea_surface_temperature; Karenia brevis; cells_per_litre).

version.description: Semantic version of the declared object.

AtlObservationStream.title: AtlObservationStream

AtlPairedInterval.description: 0.8.0 (M-2c-i). model − comparator on one metric, by season-block resampling: whole test years drawn with replacement, one draw scoring both. Summaries only; the draws stay in the instance. CLOSED: control neg_interval_extra_key proves an undeclared key (a per-draw list) is rejected AT the interval.

confidence_level.description: 0.8.0. The NOMINAL level of the percentile interval — not its delivered coverage, which is lower at few blocks (III M-2c-i F-2).

delta_estimate.description: 0.8.0. model − comparator on the full test set. Control: neg_interval_estimate_lt_minus1.

delta_lower.description: 0.8.0. Control: neg_interval_lower_lt_minus1. Nearest miss NOT caught: delta_lower > delta_upper (cross-slot arithmetic; atlantis_core: board.assert_interval).

n_blocks.description: 0.8.0. The number of test seasons resampled. At least 2 (one season admits no resample). Control: neg_interval_n_blocks_1. Nearest miss NOT caught: n_blocks ≠ the test years the split names (atlantis_core: board.assert_interval).

n_degenerate.description: 0.8.0. Draws that held a single class and could score neither metric — counted and left out, never imputed.

season_start_month.description: 0.8.0 (III M-2c-i F-5, ruling 5). The month a season-year starts in (1 = calendar year). A season is named by the year it starts; with a start month other than 1 the test window's edges are partial seasons, each a block. Controls: neg_interval_season_start_month_0 · neg_interval_season_start_month_13. Nearest miss NOT caught: a start month that cuts the instance's events in two (the steward's choice, disclosed).

spans_zero.description: 0.8.0. True when delta_lower ≤ 0 ≤ delta_upper — reported as exactly that. Control: neg_interval_without_spans_zero. Nearest miss NOT caught: a flag that disagrees with the bounds (atlantis_core: board.assert_interval).

AtlPairedInterval.title: AtlPairedInterval

AtlRealisation.description: 0.9.0. The loop closed in an instance — realised, tested, written up either way.

realised_in.description: 0.9.0. The instance (vault name) that realised the row.

realised_vital.description: 0.9.0. The AtlVital whose hypothesis_ref names this row.

shap_mean_abs.description: 0.9.0. Mean |SHAP| of the realised vital (or its group) on test — a summary, never per-patient.

write_up.description: 0.9.0. Memo or board-entry pointer — written either way (T8).

AtlRealisation.title: AtlRealisation

AtlSpatialUnit.description: The patient's space — one of these × one time step is a patient row. Passes the instance test (an MPA zone is countable), independence (it outlives any model) and lifecycle (boundaries change by ruling, versioned). Geometry is a pointer: Atlantis never holds a polygon.

external_id.description: SHOULD be present when unit_kind = mpa_zone. NOT ENFORCED: LinkML rules have no warning severity, and an error would be wrong (some zones have no WDPA row). A validator's warning (README §Known limits). Positive: pos_mpa_zone_wdpa.

geometry_ref.description: POINTER to the geometry (a file path in the instance, a WDPA id, or a coordinate RULE string such as the exemplar's `lat >= 27.6`). Never inline coordinates. DENYLIST (operator ruling, M-1c): rejects a value that opens as a GeoJSON/array literal (`{` or `[`), opens as WKT/EWKT (POINT · LINESTRING · POLYGON · MULTI* · GEOMETRYCOLLECTION, any case, optional SRID=n; and Z/M), contains a decimal lat,lon pair anywhere (separated by `,` `;` or whitespace, optional N/S on the first number), or is blank. ONE CONTROL PER ARM, each built to evade every other arm (III review F-1; each arm's removal turns exactly its control red — M-1c AAR): neg_geometry_arm_brace (`{…}` with integer coords) · neg_geometry_arm_wkt (`POINT(-80 25)`, integers) · neg_geometry_arm_ewkt_case (`srid=4326;point(-80 25)`) · neg_geometry_arm_pair (`see 25.1, -80.4`) · neg_geometry_arm_blank (`'  '`); realistic composites: neg_inline_geometry_wkt · _geojson · _bbox (the exemplar's own region_boxes row). Nearest misses NOT caught: integer-only or DMS coordinates (`25 -80`, `25°07′N 80°24′W`); query-string pairs (`lat=27.6&lon=-82.5`); projected/UTM metres with one decimal side (`456789 3045678.9`); WKT after a newline with integer coords. FALSE REJECTS (by design, named): any two decimals side by side — an interval rule `lat in [24.5, 27.6)` (write it as the exemplar's grammar does: `lat >= 24.5 and lat < 27.6`), a path like `regions_v1.2 3.4.gpkg`, prose like `release 2.1 3.0`. A pointer to a file that itself holds partner coordinates passes by design — the file lives in the instance.

name.description: Human label. Never a partner site's name when the instance's posture is partner or human_subject.

recorded_by.description: Agent or operator id (e.g. agent_proteus, stanley).

unit_id.description: Instance-local id; prefix fixed so ids are greppable across instances. Control: neg_unit_id_prefix.

version.description: Semantic version of the declared object.

AtlSpatialUnit.title: AtlSpatialUnit

AtlVital.description: One feature on the patient grid: where it comes from, how it is made, what it is for. Replaces the exemplar's hard-coded FEATURE_GROUPS / FEATURE_DOC (P1 M-1b). The tag is reviewable here instead of buried in code.

group.description: Feature group for grouped SHAP and ablation (counts · surveillance · season · sst · discharge …).

hypothesis_ref.description: Pointer to a hypothesis-ledger row (P3) when the vital exists because the literature asserted it.

lag.description: In time steps. 0 = the patient's current step.

monotone.description: Monotone constraint passed to the learner, only where physics is unambiguous. 0 = none.

name.description: Human label. Never a partner site's name when the instance's posture is partner or human_subject.

owner.description: REQUIRED and non-blank when tag = lever (AtlVital rule): who can move it (for the exemplar's S-79 releases, the Army Corps and the South Florida Water Management District, as the exemplar page names them; for a closure, the body that rules it).

recorded_by.description: Agent or operator id (e.g. agent_proteus, stanley).

tag.description: Closed enum. Control: neg_vital_tag_driver (`driver` — a causal word — rejected AT the tag; SHAP is never a cause). Nearest miss NOT caught: a lever/proxy tag that is wrong for the ecosystem (a review question, not a shape).

transform.description: The feature recipe in words or a registry key (log10(1+x) weekly max; anomaly vs training-era climatology; rolling max).

version.description: Semantic version of the declared object.

window.description: In time steps, for rolling transforms.

AtlVital.title: AtlVital

CitationSource.description: 0.9.0. The index or portal the cited work was retrieved through (provenance of the retrieval, not of the work). local.
CitationSource.title: CitationSource

Claim.description: What an evaluation is allowed to claim (SO-4). local. Default is method_demonstration; the other value needs the instance owner's written ruling naming the agencies that run the real forecast.
Claim.title: Claim

Direction.description: Which way the threshold crossing goes. local.
Direction.title: Direction

DriverDirection.description: 0.9.0. Which way the literature says the driver moves the event's probability. local. Distinct from Direction (which way a threshold CROSSING goes). `threshold`: the paper names a level past which the effect appears; `nonmonotone`: an optimum or a U-shape.
DriverDirection.title: DriverDirection

EcosystemType.description: 0.9.0 (M-3b-i). The hypothesis ledger's join key across instances (hypotheses README rule 5) — a coral DHW driver asserted in Palau is a candidate vital in the Keys. Bound to ENVO BIOME terms (crosswalk row envo, moved from deferred to adopted at 0.9.0; ids looked up in OLS on 2026-10-12, none obsolete). Scope of the binding: this enum only — AtlSpatialUnit carries no ENVO term (its bind_when is unchanged). A new ecosystem type is a new value with its looked-up term.
EcosystemType.title: EcosystemType

EvidenceClass.description: 0.9.0. What kind of evidence the cited work offers for the claim. local (playbook §C.2).
EvidenceClass.title: EvidenceClass

EvidenceTier.description: Review tier of a declared object. local — RareArchive's draft→reviewed→validated→published ladder, minus `published` (the board is the publication).
EvidenceTier.title: EvidenceTier

HypothesisSource.description: 0.9.0. Where a hypothesis came from. local. `steward_expert` carries the steward's consent to be named or is attributed to the instance (README rule 4); `model_finding` is a SHAP surprise promoted to a hypothesis.
HypothesisSource.title: HypothesisSource

IntervalComparator.description: The no-model comparator a paired interval measures the model against (0.8.0, M-2c-i). local — names a baseline of the method. `climatology`: the week-of-year onset rate (T11). Further comparators (persistence, trend, a calendar + signal logistic) are added only with their own controls.

IntervalMetric.description: The threshold-free metric a paired interval is drawn on (0.8.0, M-2c-i). local. A budget's precision/recall are read beside the interval in `climatology_alert_budgets`, not inside it.
IntervalMetric.title: IntervalMetric

LagUnit.description: 0.9.0. The unit a literature lag is stated in. local — the paper's own unit, converted to the instance's time step at realisation, not here.
LagUnit.title: LagUnit

Modality.description: How a stream speaks. local, informed by GOOS EOV platform classes (not bound in v0 — crosswalk row 7).
Modality.title: Modality

RealisationResult.description: 0.9.0. What the instance's test said. local. `not_supported` rows are kept and written up (T8; README rule 3). `supported` means the realised vital carried attribution as the paper predicts — never that the mechanism is true.
RealisationResult.title: RealisationResult

ResampleUnit.description: What a paired interval resamples (0.8.0, M-2c-i). local. `season_year`: whole seasons, each starting at the evaluation's `season_start_month` (1 = calendar year) — zone-weeks within a season are one event seen many times, so a row resample would claim an independence the data do not have.
ResampleUnit.title: ResampleUnit

ThresholdSource.description: Where an alert threshold was fixed (M-1e, F-8). local — no external vocabulary names this. `validation`: on scores the model was not trained on, before test was scored — the reading a steward can staff against. `test`: the quantile of the scored test set itself, chosen after the fact (hab's reading; grandfathered entries only).
ThresholdSource.title: ThresholdSource

TimeStep.description: The patient's time step. local — ISO 8601 durations would over-specify; `cruise` is irregular by design.
TimeStep.title: TimeStep

UnitKind.description: The kind of spatial unit a patient is. local — no external vocabulary enumerates "the unit a steward manages"; `mpa_zone` is bound to WDPA/MPAtlas ids through AtlSpatialUnit.external_id, not through this enum.
UnitKind.title: UnitKind

VitalTag.description: What a feature is FOR a steward. local — this is the method's own vocabulary (pattern step 8). A tag is a human bridge to action; it is never a causal claim.
VitalTag.title: VitalTag
